        +-> floating:<id>      selection / projection / conversation / detail

                                |

  DiagramSearchPanel + MappingDiagramExplorer + ChangeSessionPreview

  loadProjectRepresentations('current') + storage.load() in parallel

===========================================================================
MappingDocumentController
  context: CanvasEditingContext {contextId} -- runtime handle only
       |
       v
DefaultCanvasHistoryService
  WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
  object handles isolate viewers of the same persisted context
       |
       +-> openContext(document, view, history?) -> frozen handle
       +-> state -> checkpointId, document, view, canUndo, canRedo
       +-> document -> resolved document
       +-> resolve(context, diagramId) -> DiagramView
       +-> append(document, view, correspondence?) -> history.append
       +-> navigate(redo?) / reset
       |     linked transfer -> reject local navigate
       |     "Use workspace undo/redo for a canvas transfer."
       +-> exportContext / forkContext / adopt
       +-> persistenceChanges(since?) / retireTransactions(ids)
       +-> prepareTransfer / transferBoundary / prepareTransferNavigation
LOCAL COMMIT
  controller append -> new checkpoint ID -> CanvasSession.onCommit
       |
       v
  CanvasWorkspace.onPersist(ids) -> WorkspacePersistence.sync(ids)
       |
       +-> per-session cursor -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
       +-> historyChanges(id, delta) -> revision/ + checkpoint/ records
       |   new session: remove obsolete graph records in same batch
       +-> metadata + baseline + canvas + viewport + workspace index
       |   viewState.captureDisplay / captureCamera at persistence boundary
       v
  RecordStorage.batch(changes)
    synchronous cache + pending changes coalesced by key
    -> scheduled pump -> {requestId, expectedRevision, changes}
    -> WorkspaceStorage worker -> /api/mapping/workspace/records
    -> acknowledged revision; flush waits for captured sequence

COORDINATED COPY / MOVE
  MappingPage.beginTransfer -> source canvasRevisionId + selected IDs
       |
       v
  busy guard + source checkpoint check + capture workspace
  runWorkspaceTask('transfer', source/destination histories, input)
       |
       v
  prepared source + destination states + transaction
  assemble workspace.documents + workspace.transfers
       |
       v
  publishTransfer -> WorkspaceStorage.save(workspace)
    flush -> worker project(snapshot) -> RecordStorage.commit(changes)
    definitive REJECTED -> restore prior cache; operation throws
    ambiguous response -> retry identical request/ID
       |
       v
  acknowledgement -> installWorkspace -> sessions + active destination
  undo/redo: boundary -> prepareTransferNavigation for both contexts
    newer overlapping transfers block undo; both canvases required
    update both states + transaction -> same publishTransfer path
